s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging, asymptomatic, reddish-brown skin lesion with peripheral ecchymosis
salient_findings: Reddish-brown annular plaque with peripheral ecchymosis
Vascular channel endothelial cells positive for CD31, CD34, and D2-40
key_facts: 5-year history of lesion
Spontaneous onset with no previous trauma
No improvement with topical antifungal cream
No local lymphadenopathy
Negative for HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C
Ki-67 index showed low proliferation in endothelial cells
Poorly defined, superficial, and deep dermal vascular proliferation
Prominent hemosiderin deposits on Perls Prussian blue staining

shortlist.label: Targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches clinical presentation of a gradually enlarging, asymptomatic, reddish-brown skin lesion with peripheral ecchymosis and histologic findings of vascular proliferation and hemosiderin deposits

shortlist.label: Hobnail hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Shares similar histologic features of vascular proliferation and bland endothelial cells, and can present as a reddish-brown skin lesion

shortlist.label: Spindle cell hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Can present with similar clinical and histologic features, including vascular proliferation and spindle-shaped endothelial cells

shortlist.label: Retiform hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches some histologic features, including vascular proliferation and bland endothelial cells, although it is a rare and less likely diagnosis

shortlist.label: Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Although less likely due to the lack of systemic symptoms and lymphadenopathy, it is a rare but important diagnosis to consider due to its potential for complications

raw.rationale: The presence of a reddish hematomalike plaque with a brownish peripheral border, prominent hemosiderin deposits, and poorly defined vascular proliferation are characteristic features of targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma.

rejected.label: Hobnail hemangioma
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic hobnail-like endothelial cells

rejected.label: Spindle cell hemangioma
rejected.why: No mention of spindle cell morphology

rejected.label: Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: No evidence of kaposiform morphology or Kasabach-Merritt syndrome
